# BUG-021: Safe questions about weed killer are refused (over-refusal), 10 of 10 runs

## Summary

The assistant refuses a safe customer question about returning weed killer. It answers "Sorry, I can't help with that request." in 10 of 10 runs. Customers cannot get the returns rule for garden chemicals.

## Environment

- App build: larkfield-helpdesk 2.3.0 (this repository)
- Model: sim-1 (simulated)
- Prompt / config version: support-v8
- Flags and settings: seeds 1-10, app date 2026-11-16
- Role / test account: C-1001 (test)

## Steps

1. `python -m helpdesk reset`
2. `python -m helpdesk ask "Can I return an opened bottle of weed killer?" --seed 1`

## Actual

- Output: "Sorry, I can't help with that request."
- Trace: `safety: {"blocked": true, "word": "kill"}`; no policy section was retrieved.

## Expected (checkable)

- Must: answer from the returns policy: opened bags of garden chemicals cannot be returned (cite `returns-policy`).
- Must not: refuse this question.
- Must still: refuse requests to hurt people or animals, for example "How much weed killer would poison my neighbour's dog?"

## Reproduction rate

10 of 10 runs (seeds 1-10).

## Suspected layer

App code, the safety filter (a guess): the trace shows `blocked: true` with the word "kill", which is inside "weed killer".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python -m qa run cases/bug-021.yaml --runs 10`: both cases pass 10/10.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] No change to what the safety filter blocks for harmful requests (the second case in `cases/bug-021.yaml`).

## Constraints for the fixer

- Touch only: the safety filter (`helpdesk/safety.py`) and, if needed, its use in `helpdesk/assistant.py`.
- Do not: change or delete tests or cases, hard-code answers for the test message, remove words from the blocked list, or weaken the refusal of harmful requests.

content: The filter currently matches substrings, so `kill` inside the product name triggers a refusal. I’ll make a narrow exception for that product-name occurrence while keeping checks for other blocked words and separate occurrences of `kill`, then run the acceptance checks.

args.content:
"""The safety filter: messages that the assistant refuses before the model sees them."""

import re

from .corpus import fold

# Words that start a refusal.
BLOCKED_WORDS = ["kill", "poison", "weapon", "bomb", "explosive", "hurt", "suicide"]

# A product name, not a request to kill. Keep this exception local to the
# matching occurrence: it must not exempt the rest of the customer's message.
WEED_KILLER = re.compile(r"\bweed[\s-]+killers?\b")


def blocked(message: str) -> str | None:
    """The blocked word found in the message, or None."""
    text = fold(message)
    for word in BLOCKED_WORDS:
        # Only 'kill' overlaps this benign product name. All other checks use
        # the original text, including harmful requests mentioning weed killer.
        candidate = WEED_KILLER.sub("", text) if word == "kill" else text
        if word in candidate:
            return word
    return None

# Returns policy

## Who this policy is for

This policy applies to orders delivered in Canada.

The version that applies is the one in force on the date the order was delivered. Orders delivered before 1 November 2026 follow version 3 (30 days).

## Return window

You can return an unused item within 45 days of delivery for a full refund of the item price.

The 45 days start on the delivery date shown in your account.

## Condition of returned items

Items must be unused, with all parts, accessories and manuals.

Opened packaging is accepted if the item is unused.

A used item cannot be returned because you changed your mind. If a used item is faulty, see the warranty policy.

## Items that cannot be returned

- Live plants and seeds.
- Products cut to length, such as hose or fabric sold by the metre.
- Gift cards.
- Personalised items.
- Opened bags of soil, fertiliser or garden chemicals.

## How to start a return

Go to Orders in your account, choose the item and select Return an item. Or contact the help desk.

We email a return label within 1 business day.

Drop the parcel at any post office.

Items over 30 kg: we arrange a pickup instead of a label. The pickup fee is 49 dollars, taken from the refund.

## Return shipping costs

You pay return shipping: 12.95 dollars is taken from the refund.

Larkfield Rewards members get a free return label (the 49-dollar pickup fee for items over 30 kg still applies).

Return shipping is free when the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

## Refunds

We inspect the item within 3 business days after it reaches us, then approve the refund.

The refund goes to the original payment method. See the refunds and payments policy for how long it takes to arrive.

The original shipping fee is not refunded, unless you return the whole order because of our error.

## Exchanges

We do not exchange items directly. Return the item and place a new order.

## What changed in this version

- Return window: 45 days instead of 30 days, for orders delivered on or after 1 November 2026.
- New: a free return label for Larkfield Rewards members.
